title: The top of the stairs
steps: You have reached the top of the long stairs, where the stones are older and darker. This is where the mysterious night passages begin.
Phew! Using a loop to repeat our steps was a brilliant way to climb all those stairs!
Just ahead, a stone stair floats in the air, slowly coming and going. Somewhere down below, you hear the steady sound of footsteps: Dask is on the move again.
How do we get past him? We do not know how long he will look our way!
I have an idea. We will wait as long as he looks, and I will show you how a program can do that.
